name: loop-setup
title_zh: 项目一开工就自动铺好循环文档和状态看板的搭架工
tagline_zh: 新项目还在白纸阶段，它就把 loop.json、STATUS 看板、LOOP.md 的启动块一次铺齐。不用记模板。
tagline_en: Brand-new project? It lays down loop.json, the STATUS board, and the LOOP.md kickoff block in one pass. No.
desc_en: Use when a project needs the orchestrator-loop documents and config (claude-work/loop.json, the STATUS dashboard, the "Starting the loop" block in docs/LOOP.md), or when loop-start or loop-pause report that loop.json is missing.
why_zh: 它把「循环基建」从手抄模板变成一次命令：配置、看板、文档三件套同源生成，缺哪个文件它会主动补。
why_en: Turns loop scaffolding from copy-paste ritual into one command: config, dashboard, and docs generated from a single source. It.
limit_zh: 只认 orchestrator-loop 这一套文档结构（claude-work/loop.json、STATUS。
limit_en: Only scaffolds the orchestrator-loop layout (claude-work/loop.json, STATUS, LOOP.md). Won't touch other structures; on repos with custom loop.
title_en: Scaffold the loop docs & status board the moment a project.
